# Borchardt Construction Technology

> 3D machine-control models, site takeoffs, drone data, and GPS support prepared for practical use by construction teams.

Website: https://borchardtct.com/

## Services

- 3D model building: Machine-control and rover site models structured around the project plans and the equipment workflow.
- Site takeoffs: Quantity takeoffs for earthwork, paving, concrete, pipe, and associated materials.
- Drone data: Progress and surface-data workflows that help teams compare field conditions with project surfaces.
- GPS consulting: Setup, troubleshooting, calibration, localization, control, and crew training for supported systems.
